reviews.title: won’t open without deleting and reinstalling
reviews.text:
Feedly no longer works as a free app. It is either a blank screen, or if you try to open it from the App Store, you get a flickering screen that you can’t even read. So you have to delete the app and reinstall it. And then it will open for that session. Next time you want to use it, you have to go through the whole process again. 
I’ve been with Feedly since it was Google notes, probably nearly two decades, and I am incredibly sad to see them become so greedy that they will not allow us normal access to our own accounts in Feedly without paying a monthly subscription fee (which, as a senior, I can’t afford).

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY. Free services now cost extra
reviews.text: Ten years ago Feedly was pretty good.  Now, it charges an annual fee of c. $140 plus charges you to search in languages other than English or to get other services that previously were free. The fee structure is baffling given AI agents and models can do all this and more now for free.  You can actually get more market insights or news by setting up a regular task with the most popular AI apps. This app has no justification for the private client anymore, especially since the age of RSS feeds has passed.  The value proposition is so minimal that this app feels like a scam now.

reviews.title: Multiple Mark as Read Required to Clear, Scrolling Types Breaks
reviews.text: First of all, bring back Feedly Classic, much cleaner and less prone to issues. The current Feedly app is a navigation mess. Mark as Read requires at least 2 presses before clearing the articles and marking as read. The scrolling type randomly switches from Paged to Smooth. These bugs have persisted through multiple app updates. So perhaps you guys need stronger bug killer.

reviews.title: Broken
reviews.text: I’ve been using Feedly for years on computer, iPhone, and iPad. Recently the iPad app seems to be broken. First it would pull up the green screen with the logo, but that’s all it would do. I deleted and redownloaded, but can’t log in. It gives me the option to use Google, Apple,Microsoft or email, but selecting any of those just makes the icon flash: no login screen appears. Same thing happens if I select sign up instead of log in. I tried the same thing again after updating iOS, and still can’t get to a login screen. This makes me sad because iPad lets me read on a large ish screen somewhere other than my desk, and I miss that ability.

reviews.title: Love Feedly. Hate the new app.
reviews.text:
First of all, I haven’t been able to read more than two articles in a row before it crashes.

Secondly, do they think we’ve all gone blind? This “new” app uses huge fonts and massive amounts of white space that mean I can only see one or two articles at a time. This completely defeats the purpose of using Feedly.

I love the service, but someone was completely out of touch with any normal humans when they approved this update. And now that the Feedly Classic app has been broken by the developers, it looks like it’s time to hunt down a new service and say goodbye to Feedly.

I will gladly give five stars once this is fixed. Thank you.
